newsitem.title: USA: Duff & Phelps may cut Citizens Utilities.
newsitem.headline: Duff & Phelps may cut Citizens Utilities.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Friday it placed the ratings of Citizens Utilities Co on Rating Watch-Down, pending a full review of the company's plans for significant increased investment in the telecommunications business.
The utility company's senior unsecured debt and long-term industrial development revenue bonds are currently rated double-A-plus, Duff & Phelps said.
The company's short-term debt and commercial paper were reaffirmed at D-one-plus, Duff & Phelps said.

The move to Rating Watch "is predicated on Citizens' lower-than-projected first quarter 1997 financial perfomance and (Duff & Phelp's) expectation that the company's aggressive spending on network infrastructure and other communications-related initiatives will continue to pressure quantitative protection measures in the foreseeable future," Duff & Phelps aid.
